title: Phase 0: keep the verification build output out of the workspace
objective: Stop scripts/verify-candidate's `go build ./cmd/fake-jev` from leaving an untracked ./fake-jev binary in the workspace, which is counted by the candidate fingerprint and stales every stage artifact of a product work item.
specReferences: design §6.1 candidate fingerprint (untracked and not gitignored files are hashed)
acceptance: git check-ignore -q fake-jev exits 0, so the binary that check_go_build writes at the repository root is excluded from the candidate fingerprint
scripts/verify-candidate is unchanged: the fix is ignore coverage, not a change to the acceptance check itself
./scripts/verify-candidate FJ-001 exits 0 twice in a row, with the second run reporting a clean tree
nonGoals: no change to the Go acceptance commands in scripts/verify-candidate
no relocation of build output into the repository's committed artifacts
nextAction: add /fake-jev to .gitignore, then verify FJ-001 twice to prove the evidence chain survives a repeated verification run
notes: Observed during FJ-001 (2026-09-26): `go build ./cmd/fake-jev` writes ./fake-jev at the repository root; .gitignore lists /bin/ and /dist/ only, so the file is hashed by the candidate fingerprint and stage evidence reports stage.evidence_stale on the following run.
